content.what_it_is: MATLAB static comparison figure for the FUNWAVE-TVD vessel_propeller_effect case: a 4x2 panel snapshot (nfile=[35], L17) contrasting the no-propeller run (left column, from output_nopropeller/) against the propeller run (right column, from output/). Setup: grid sized from dep_00000 (L6, L8), x,y with dx=dy=2.0 (L10-L13), 16x8-inch jet figure (L20-L24). Per selected snapshot it loads eta, C, DchgS, DchgB from both runs (L28-L37) and plots: (421) eta1 with caxis [-0.3 1.5] titled ' without propeller, Time = <n*1.0> sec ' (L39-L46); (423) ch1*100 concentration, caxis [0.0 0.01], colorbar ' c (%) ' (L52-L57); (425) ds1 suspended-load depth change, caxis [-0.002 0.002], label ' S-load-induced (m) ' (L64-L69); (427) db1 bed-load depth change, same caxis, ' B-load-induced (m) ' (L73-L78); and mirrored right-column panels (422) eta (L82-L89), (424) ch*100 (L95-L100), (426) ds (L107-L112), (428) db (L116-L121). Exports compare.jpg at quality 100 (L126).
entities: script (no function declaration; top-level MATLAB script)
ds — DchgS suspended-load depth change, propeller run (L31)
db — DchgB bed-load depth change, propeller run (L32)
cbar — colorbar handle (L45, L56, L68, L77, L88, L99, L111, L120)

unresolved: Concentration is scaled by 100 and labeled ' c (%) ' but shown against caxis [0.0 0.01] (L53, L55, L96, L98) — i.e. displayed percent range 0..0.01%; whether C is a volume fraction such that x100 = percent is assumed, not stated.
The 1 s output interval implied by the time titles (L43, L86) must match the case input; unverifiable here.
dep is loaded (L6) only for sizing; the time-stamped name dep_00000 implies morphology output, but bed evolution itself is only shown via DchgS/DchgB fields.
The print at L126 sits outside the loop, so with multiple nfile entries only the last snapshot's figure would be exported.
